name: aladdin.motion
description: Motion tokens. Motion is functional (orient, show relationships, confirm state) — never decorative filler. All motion honors prefers-reduced-motion.
maintenance: Manually maintained. Edit here first, then frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (--duration-*/--ease-*) and frontend/tailwind.config.ts (transitionDuration/transitionTimingFunction).

fast.usage: Hover, small state changes; floor of UI transitions.

slower.usage: Rare, orchestrated entrances (e.g. the Aperture opening).

out-expo.usage: Entrances from an already-visible default; the aperture-opening feel.

rules.functional-only: Animate to communicate hierarchy or state; never delay a user task with decorative animation.
rules.cheap-properties: Prefer transform/opacity/filter; avoid animating layout properties.
rules.reduced-motion: Every animation/transition collapses to near-instant under prefers-reduced-motion (enforced globally in globals.css).
